about: Who owns which files. Mirrors CHALLENGE.md section 5; a human changes both together. Read by scripts/lane-check.mjs, which the pre-push hook and CI run. A pattern ending in / covers the folder; **/*.ext covers matching files under a folder; anything else is one exact path. The most specific match wins.

frozen.why: Co-op works; leave it alone unless it breaks (CHALLENGE.md section 2). A change needs a human's yes.

humanOnly.why: Humans own these, or a change here means a new dependency (AGENTS.md rule 7).

shared.why: Anyone may make small edits. Keep them short and say what changed in the commit message.
